candidates.claim: rtr-01 has a management-VLAN interface (GigabitEthernet0 10.10.99.12/24) and a default route via 198.51.100.1 out GigabitEthernet0/0/0, whose only ACL (EDGE_IN) is applied inbound, so MGMT traffic routed by rtr-01 can reach OUTSIDE without passing the fw-01 MGMT_IN and OUTSIDE_IN policy.
candidates.remediation: Confirm the intended egress path for MGMT, remove or filter the rtr-01 default route via 198.51.100.1 (or the second default via 10.10.99.1 that competes with it), and keep MGMT egress through fw-01.

candidates.claim: The OT_IN entry at position 4 (permit tcp 10.10.10.22/32 to 10.10.20.10/32 port 5450) is an addition to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OT_IN entry against its change record; it matches approved service A1, so either approve it into the baseline or remove it.
